name: Sprout Spawner
description: Right-click clear ground to plant a blank sprout. Crowded locations near trees or order pots are refused.

name: Double Cut
description: Left-click a tree, then right-click a branch to add two nested cuts at that branch.

name: Iteration
description: Right-click a tree to take a cutting, right-click clear ground to duplicate it, right-click an order pot to deliver a matching cutting, and press Backspace to release a held cutting.
